title: EverFile
tagline: Store your files permanently in FileCoin blockchain with EverFile cloud drive
description: Store files permanently in FileCoin blockchain with EverFile cloud drive. Using Lighthouse we can easily upload any file and optionally encrypt it. With a simple and easy to use user interface files and folders can be navigated and previewed. Never lose a file again due to hosting problems or expired services, store them permanently in EverFile.
how_its_made: Using Metamask as main wallet and Lighthouse as uploader utility we could build a complete cloud file manager. NodeJS on the server, PostgreSQL as database for replication, HTML, CSS and JS for browser based app was all we needed to complete the simplest UI. Storage contract built in Solidity and deployed to FVM for permanently tracking files and folders.
